question: Is the VNB growth sustainable?
with_answer:
The June jump is **real but not guaranteed to persist** — it rests on three operational levers that can reverse:

| Driver | Jun 2025 status | Sustainability risk |
|---|---|---|
| Active Agency agents | 390 active (85% active ratio) | Agency churn rate is **12.6%** vs 0% for Banca/Brokerage (`channels`) |
| Agency productivity | ~$10K per active agent | Inactive agents contribute $0 productivity (`agents`) |
| Product mix | Unit-Linked (25% margin) at 21% of Agency mix (`mix`) | Mix can shift back toward lower-margin Term Life (10%) |

The monthly narrative confirms the June gain came from **more active agents, higher productivity and a richer Unit-Linked mix** (`vnb_monthly.narrative`). Those are management-controllable but not automatic.

The scenario analysis (`scenario_data`) also shows the stretch: to **double** total VNB, Agency would need **420 active agents** (vs 390 now) and a productivity uplift — i.e., growth requires continued headcount and productivity gains, not just momentum.

**Bottom line:** sustainable only if churn is contained, inactive agents are re-activated or replaced, and the higher-margin mix is defended.
